dialogue.text: A long time ago, in the heart of the North Pole, Santa Claus and his elves were busy preparing
dialogue.zh: 很久以前，在北極的中心，聖誕老人和他的精靈們正忙著準備
dialogue.ja: ずっと昔、北極の中心でサンタクロースと彼のエルフたちは忙しく準備をしていました。
dialogue.local: A long time ago, in the heart of the North Pole, Santa Claus and his elves were busy preparing
dialogue.en: A long time ago, in the heart of the North Pole, Santa Claus and his elves were busy preparing

dialogue.text: for Christmas.
dialogue.zh: 迎接聖誕節。
dialogue.ja: クリスマスのために。
dialogue.local: for Christmas.
dialogue.en: for Christmas.

dialogue.text: Back then, Santa didn't have flying reindeer.
dialogue.zh: 那時候，聖誕老人還沒有會飛的馴鹿。
dialogue.ja: その頃、サンタには飛ぶトナカイはいませんでした。
dialogue.local: Back then, Santa didn't have flying reindeer.
dialogue.en: Back then, Santa didn't have flying reindeer.

dialogue.text: He delivered gifts on foot with a magical sack.
dialogue.zh: 他用一個魔法袋徒步送禮物。
dialogue.ja: 彼は魔法の袋を持って徒歩でプレゼントを配っていました。
dialogue.local: He delivered gifts on foot with a magical sack.
dialogue.en: He delivered gifts on foot with a magical sack.

dialogue.text: As more children started celebrating Christmas, Santa realized he needed help to deliver
dialogue.zh: 隨著越來越多的孩子開始慶祝聖誕節，聖誕老人意識到他需要幫助才能送完
dialogue.ja: 子どもたちがクリスマスを祝うようになると、サンタは一晩でプレゼントを届けるために助けが必要だと気づきました。
dialogue.local: As more children started celebrating Christmas, Santa realized he needed help to deliver
dialogue.en: As more children started celebrating Christmas, Santa realized he needed help to deliver

dialogue.text: presents to all the children in one night.
dialogue.zh: 禮物給所有的孩子們。
dialogue.ja: すべての子どもたちに一晩でプレゼントを届けるために。
dialogue.local: presents to all the children in one night.
dialogue.en: presents to all the children in one night.

dialogue.text: That's when the story of the reindeer began.
dialogue.zh: 這就是馴鹿故事的開始。
dialogue.ja: そこでトナカイの物語が始まりました。
dialogue.local: That's when the story of the reindeer began.
dialogue.en: That's when the story of the reindeer began.

dialogue.text: One snowy winter evening, Santa was walking through the forest when he stumbled upon
dialogue.zh: 一個雪白的冬夜，聖誕老人走在森林中，偶然發現了
dialogue.ja: ある雪の降る冬の夜、サンタは森を歩いていると、偶然にも
dialogue.local: One snowy winter evening, Santa was walking through the forest when he stumbled upon
dialogue.en: One snowy winter evening, Santa was walking through the forest when he stumbled upon

dialogue.text: a group of reindeer huddled together under a sparkling aurora.
dialogue.zh: 一群聚集在閃耀極光下的馴鹿。
dialogue.ja: 輝くオーロラの下に集まっている一群のトナカイに出会いました。
dialogue.local: a group of reindeer huddled together under a sparkling aurora.
dialogue.en: a group of reindeer huddled together under a sparkling aurora.

dialogue.text: These were no ordinary reindeer.
dialogue.zh: 這些不是普通的馴鹿。
dialogue.ja: それらは普通のトナカイではありませんでした。
dialogue.local: These were no ordinary reindeer.
dialogue.en: These were no ordinary reindeer.

dialogue.text: They had shimmering antlers that glowed faintly in the dark and hooves that left a trail
dialogue.zh: 牠們有著在黑暗中微微發光的閃爍鹿角，蹄子踏過會留下
dialogue.ja: 彼らは暗闇でほのかに光る輝く角を持ち、蹄は
dialogue.local: They had shimmering antlers that glowed faintly in the dark and hooves that left a trail
dialogue.en: They had shimmering antlers that glowed faintly in the dark and hooves that left a trail

dialogue.text: of stardust.
dialogue.zh: 星塵的痕跡。
dialogue.ja: 星の粉の跡を残していました。
dialogue.local: of stardust.
dialogue.en: of stardust.

dialogue.text: The leader of the group, a proud and swift reindeer named Dasher, stepped forward.
dialogue.zh: 這群的領袖，一隻驕傲且迅速的馴鹿，名叫達舍，走了出來。
dialogue.ja: グループのリーダーである誇り高く素早いトナカイ、ダッシャーが前に出ました。
dialogue.local: The leader of the group, a proud and swift reindeer named Dasher, stepped forward.
dialogue.en: The leader of the group, a proud and swift reindeer named Dasher, stepped forward.

dialogue.text: He explained that they were part of a magical herd, born from the light of the northern
dialogue.zh: 他解釋說牠們是魔法馴鹿群的一部分，誕生於北方光芒之中。
dialogue.ja: 彼は彼らが北の空の光から生まれた魔法の群れの一部だと説明しました。
dialogue.local: He explained that they were part of a magical herd, born from the light of the northern
dialogue.en: He explained that they were part of a magical herd, born from the light of the northern

dialogue.text: skies.
dialogue.zh: 天空。
dialogue.ja: 空の光から生まれたと。
dialogue.local: skies.
dialogue.en: skies.

dialogue.text: Each of them had been gifted with a special talent, and they had been waiting for someone
dialogue.zh: 牠們每一隻都有特殊的天賦，並且一直在等待一個
dialogue.ja: それぞれが特別な才能を授かっており、純粋な心を持つ誰かを待っていました。
dialogue.local: Each of them had been gifted with a special talent, and they had been waiting for someone
dialogue.en: Each of them had been gifted with a special talent, and they had been waiting for someone

dialogue.text: with a pure heart to guide them.
dialogue.zh: 擁有純潔心靈的人來引導牠們。
dialogue.ja: 彼らを導く純粋な心の持ち主を。
dialogue.local: with a pure heart to guide them.
dialogue.en: with a pure heart to guide them.

dialogue.text: Santa smiled and said, would you help me bring joy to children around the world?
dialogue.zh: 聖誕老人微笑著說，你們願意幫我帶給全世界的孩子們歡樂嗎？
dialogue.ja: サンタは微笑んで言いました、「世界中の子どもたちに喜びを届けるのを手伝ってくれますか？」
dialogue.local: Santa smiled and said, would you help me bring joy to children around the world?
dialogue.en: Santa smiled and said, would you help me bring joy to children around the world?

dialogue.text: The reindeer eagerly agreed, and so the team was formed.
dialogue.zh: 馴鹿們熱切地答應了，於是團隊成立了。
dialogue.ja: トナカイたちは喜んで同意し、こうしてチームが結成されました。
dialogue.local: The reindeer eagerly agreed, and so the team was formed.
dialogue.en: The reindeer eagerly agreed, and so the team was formed.

dialogue.text: The original team consisted of eight reindeer, each chosen for their unique abilities.
dialogue.zh: 最初的團隊由八隻馴鹿組成，每隻都因其獨特能力被選中。
dialogue.ja: 最初のチームは8頭のトナカイで構成されており、それぞれが独自の能力で選ばれました。
dialogue.local: The original team consisted of eight reindeer, each chosen for their unique abilities.
dialogue.en: The original team consisted of eight reindeer, each chosen for their unique abilities.

dialogue.text: One, Dasher, known for his speed, Dasher is the fastest of the reindeer, and leads the
dialogue.zh: 第一隻，達舍，以速度著稱，達舍是馴鹿中最快的，領導起飛時的隊伍。
dialogue.ja: 一番目はダッシャー、速さで知られ、トナカイの中で最も速く、離陸時に先頭を務めます。
dialogue.local: One, Dasher, known for his speed, Dasher is the fastest of the reindeer, and leads the
dialogue.en: One, Dasher, known for his speed, Dasher is the fastest of the reindeer, and leads the

dialogue.text: charge during takeoff.
dialogue.zh: 起飛時的衝鋒。
dialogue.ja: 離陸時の先導役です。
dialogue.local: charge during takeoff.
dialogue.en: charge during takeoff.

dialogue.text: Second, Dasher, graceful in light on her hooves.
dialogue.zh: 第二隻，達舍，蹄子輕盈優雅。
dialogue.ja: 二番目はダッシャー、軽やかな蹄さばきで優雅です。
dialogue.local: Second, Dasher, graceful in light on her hooves.
dialogue.en: Second, Dasher, graceful in light on her hooves.

dialogue.text: Dasher helps keep the sleigh balanced during tricky flights.
dialogue.zh: 達舍幫助雪橇在複雜的飛行中保持平衡。
dialogue.ja: ダッシャーは難しい飛行中にそりのバランスを保つのを助けます。
dialogue.local: Dasher helps keep the sleigh balanced during tricky flights.
dialogue.en: Dasher helps keep the sleigh balanced during tricky flights.

dialogue.text: Third, Prancer, always cheerful and energetic.
dialogue.zh: 第三隻，普蘭瑟，總是開朗有活力。
dialogue.ja: 三番目はプランサー、いつも陽気で元気いっぱいです。
dialogue.local: Third, Prancer, always cheerful and energetic.
dialogue.en: Third, Prancer, always cheerful and energetic.

dialogue.text: Prancer boosts the team's spirits, even on the longest nights.
dialogue.zh: 普蘭瑟提升團隊士氣，即使在最長的夜晚。
dialogue.ja: プランサーは最も長い夜でもチームの士気を高めます。
dialogue.local: Prancer boosts the team's spirits, even on the longest nights.
dialogue.en: Prancer boosts the team's spirits, even on the longest nights.

dialogue.text: Four, Vixen, clever and resourceful.
dialogue.zh: 第四隻，維克森，聰明且足智多謀。
dialogue.ja: 四番目はヴィクセン、賢くて機転が利きます。
dialogue.local: Four, Vixen, clever and resourceful.
dialogue.en: Four, Vixen, clever and resourceful.

dialogue.text: Vixen uses her wit to navigate the skies and solve any problems on the journey.
dialogue.zh: 維克森用她的智慧導航天空，解決旅途中任何問題。
dialogue.ja: ヴィクセンは機知を使って空を航行し、旅の途中の問題を解決します。
dialogue.local: Vixen uses her wit to navigate the skies and solve any problems on the journey.
dialogue.en: Vixen uses her wit to navigate the skies and solve any problems on the journey.

dialogue.text: Five, comet, the strongest reindeer, comet can pull the sleigh through the roughest weather.
dialogue.zh: 第五隻，彗星，最強壯的馴鹿，彗星能拉著雪橇穿越最惡劣的天氣。
dialogue.ja: 五番目はコメット、最も力強いトナカイで、荒天の中でもそりを引くことができます。
dialogue.local: Five, comet, the strongest reindeer, comet can pull the sleigh through the roughest weather.
dialogue.en: Five, comet, the strongest reindeer, comet can pull the sleigh through the roughest weather.

dialogue.text: Six, Cupid, with a warm and loving heart, Cupid spreads kindness and joy wherever they fly.
dialogue.zh: 第六隻，丘比特，擁有溫暖且充滿愛的心，丘比特在飛行中傳播善意與歡樂。
dialogue.ja: 六番目はキューピッド、温かく愛情深い心を持ち、飛ぶ先々で親切と喜びを広げます。
dialogue.local: Six, Cupid, with a warm and loving heart, Cupid spreads kindness and joy wherever they fly.
dialogue.en: Six, Cupid, with a warm and loving heart, Cupid spreads kindness and joy wherever they fly.

dialogue.text: Seventh, Donor, known for his booming thunderous voice, Donor leads the reindeer in cheerful
dialogue.zh: 第七隻，唐納，以他洪亮如雷的聲音聞名，唐納帶領馴鹿們唱著歡樂的歌。
dialogue.ja: 七番目はドナー、雷のような大きな声で知られ、トナカイたちを陽気な歌でリードします。
dialogue.local: Seventh, Donor, known for his booming thunderous voice, Donor leads the reindeer in cheerful
dialogue.en: Seventh, Donor, known for his booming thunderous voice, Donor leads the reindeer in cheerful

dialogue.text: songs.
dialogue.zh: 歌曲中。
dialogue.ja: 歌を歌います。
dialogue.local: songs.
dialogue.en: songs.

dialogue.text: Eight, Vixen, as quick as lightning, Vixen adds an extra spark of magic to the team.
dialogue.zh: 第八隻，維克森，像閃電般迅速，維克森為團隊增添了額外的魔力火花。
dialogue.ja: 八番目はヴィクセン、稲妻のように速く、チームにさらなる魔法の輝きを加えます。
dialogue.local: Eight, Vixen, as quick as lightning, Vixen adds an extra spark of magic to the team.
dialogue.en: Eight, Vixen, as quick as lightning, Vixen adds an extra spark of magic to the team.

dialogue.text: One Christmas Eve, a fierce blizzard covered the world in thick snow and fog, Santa worried
dialogue.zh: 一個聖誕夜，猛烈的暴風雪覆蓋了世界，厚厚的雪和霧，聖誕老人擔心
dialogue.ja: あるクリスマスイブ、激しい吹雪が世界を厚い雪と霧で覆い、サンタは心配しました。
dialogue.local: One Christmas Eve, a fierce blizzard covered the world in thick snow and fog, Santa worried
dialogue.en: One Christmas Eve, a fierce blizzard covered the world in thick snow and fog, Santa worried

dialogue.text: he wouldn't be able to deliver the gifts.
dialogue.zh: 他可能無法送達禮物。
dialogue.ja: プレゼントを届けられないのではないかと。
dialogue.local: he wouldn't be able to deliver the gifts.
dialogue.en: he wouldn't be able to deliver the gifts.

dialogue.text: That's when he heard about a young reindeer with an unusual gift, a glowing red nose.
dialogue.zh: 就在那時，他聽說有一隻擁有特殊天賦的年輕馴鹿，擁有發光的紅鼻子。
dialogue.ja: その時、彼は珍しい才能を持つ若いトナカイ、光る赤い鼻の話を聞きました。
dialogue.local: That's when he heard about a young reindeer with an unusual gift, a glowing red nose.
dialogue.en: That's when he heard about a young reindeer with an unusual gift, a glowing red nose.

dialogue.text: This reindeer, Rudolph, had always been shy because of his bright nose, but Santa saw
dialogue.zh: 這隻馴鹿，魯道夫，因為他明亮的鼻子一直很害羞，但聖誕老人看到
dialogue.ja: このトナカイ、ルドルフは明るい鼻のためにいつも恥ずかしがり屋でしたが、サンタはそれを
dialogue.local: This reindeer, Rudolph, had always been shy because of his bright nose, but Santa saw
dialogue.en: This reindeer, Rudolph, had always been shy because of his bright nose, but Santa saw

dialogue.text: it as a blessing.
dialogue.zh: 視為一種祝福。
dialogue.ja: 祝福だと見なしました。
dialogue.local: it as a blessing.
dialogue.en: it as a blessing.

dialogue.text: Rudolph led the sleigh that night, lighting away through the storm.
dialogue.zh: 魯道夫那晚帶領雪橇，穿越風暴照亮前路。
dialogue.ja: ルドルフはその夜そりを先導し、嵐の中を照らしながら進みました。
dialogue.local: Rudolph led the sleigh that night, lighting away through the storm.
dialogue.en: Rudolph led the sleigh that night, lighting away through the storm.

dialogue.text: From that day on Rudolph became the ninth member of the team, ensuring that no Christmas
dialogue.zh: 從那天起，魯道夫成為團隊的第九名成員，確保沒有聖誕節
dialogue.ja: その日からルドルフはチームの9番目のメンバーとなり、どんなクリスマスも
dialogue.local: From that day on Rudolph became the ninth member of the team, ensuring that no Christmas
dialogue.en: From that day on Rudolph became the ninth member of the team, ensuring that no Christmas

dialogue.text: delivery would ever be delayed again.
dialogue.zh: 送禮會再度延誤。
dialogue.ja: 配達が遅れることがないようにしました。
dialogue.local: delivery would ever be delayed again.
dialogue.en: delivery would ever be delayed again.

dialogue.text: Today, Santa's reindeer are more than just helpers.
dialogue.zh: 如今，聖誕老人的馴鹿不僅僅是幫手。
dialogue.ja: 今日、サンタのトナカイは単なる助手以上の存在です。
dialogue.local: Today, Santa's reindeer are more than just helpers.
dialogue.en: Today, Santa's reindeer are more than just helpers.

dialogue.text: They are symbols of teamwork, courage, and the magic of Christmas.
dialogue.zh: 牠們是團隊合作、勇氣和聖誕魔法的象徵。
dialogue.ja: 彼らはチームワーク、勇気、そしてクリスマスの魔法の象徴です。
dialogue.local: They are symbols of teamwork, courage, and the magic of Christmas.
dialogue.en: They are symbols of teamwork, courage, and the magic of Christmas.

dialogue.text: Each one brings something unique to the team, proving that everyone has a special role
dialogue.zh: 每一隻都為團隊帶來獨特之處，證明每個人都有特別的角色
dialogue.ja: それぞれがチームに独自のものをもたらし、誰もが特別な役割を持っていることを証明しています。
dialogue.local: Each one brings something unique to the team, proving that everyone has a special role
dialogue.en: Each one brings something unique to the team, proving that everyone has a special role

dialogue.text: to play.
dialogue.zh: 可以扮演。
dialogue.ja: 果たすべき役割があるのです。
dialogue.local: to play.
dialogue.en: to play.

dialogue.text: Whenever children look up at the starry sky on Christmas Eve, they might just catch a glimpse
dialogue.zh: 每當孩子們在聖誕夜仰望星空時，他們或許能瞥見
dialogue.ja: 子どもたちがクリスマスイブの星空を見上げるとき、彼らはもしかすると一瞬だけ
dialogue.local: Whenever children look up at the starry sky on Christmas Eve, they might just catch a glimpse
dialogue.en: Whenever children look up at the starry sky on Christmas Eve, they might just catch a glimpse

dialogue.text: of Santa and his nine reindeer flying by, spreading joy and love to the world.
dialogue.zh: 聖誕老人和他的九隻馴鹿飛過，將歡樂與愛傳遍世界。
dialogue.ja: サンタと彼の9頭のトナカイが飛んでいるのを見られるかもしれません。世界に喜びと愛を広げながら。
dialogue.local: of Santa and his nine reindeer flying by, spreading joy and love to the world.
dialogue.en: of Santa and his nine reindeer flying by, spreading joy and love to the world.
